title: Send a catering request from the menu

fields.summary: As an office manager ordering pastries for a meeting, I want an 'Order for your office' button on the menu that sends a catering request, so that my order arrives instead of getting lost on the phone.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [screenshot] state: `/menu` with the seeded menu; expected: one "Order for your office" button on the menu page
2. [recording] state: `/menu` as the seeded office manager pressing "Order for your office"; expected: a form with 6 fields: company, name, email, phone, date, and how many people
3. [api-trace] state: the seeded office manager sends the form with all 6 fields; expected: POST /api/orders creates 1 order that holds the company, name, email, phone, date, and number of people
4. [metric] state: the app's log output while the seeded office manager sends the form; expected: 0 lines containing the seeded name, email, or phone number
fields.measure: catering requests received through the form per week
fields.scenario: As the seeded office manager, open /menu, press the button, fill in the form with the seeded company, name, email, phone, date, and 12 people, and send it; read the created order and the app's log output.
fields.environment: local app with the seeded synthetic office manager; never production
fields.checkpoints:
1. The menu shows the one button, and it opens the six-field form (criteria 1, 2)
2. Sending the form creates the order with the request's details (criterion 3)
3. The logs hold none of the form's personal data (criterion 4)
fields.assumptions:
- Catering requests reuse POST /api/orders, as orders do today.
- The seeded office manager and company are synthetic data.
fields.open_questions: - answered: which page PDP means (the menu, /menu)
fields.parked_ideas: - prices and invoices: pricing a catering order and invoicing the company (out of scope, said the human)
fields.provenance:
Request: "The PDP needs a CTA for B2B catering orders, and keep PII out of the logs. It belongs under Feature #60 (Catering)."
Term: "PDP" → the menu, `/menu`, where each product has its tile; "By PDP I mean the menu, /menu, where each product has its tile"
Term: "CTA" → one call-to-action button that starts a catering order; "Yes, a call to action: one button that starts a catering order"
Term: "B2B" → offices that order trays of pastries for meetings; "B2B means offices that order trays of pastries for meetings"
Term: "PII" → customer names, emails, and phone numbers; "PII is personal data: customer names, emails, and phone numbers"
1. confirmed (idea.slice/smallest-slice): "Just an 'Order for your office' button on the menu page"; facts: component:ProductTile
2. confirmed (idea.slice/smallest-slice): "a short form: company, name, email, phone, date, and how many people"
3. confirmed (idea.outcome/change): "Every catering request should arrive as an order we can see"; facts: route:/api/orders, event:order_submitted
4. confirmed (request/scope): "no customer name, email, or phone number may show up in any of our logs" / "customer names, emails, and phone numbers"
